source_description: The wine bottle with a narrow neck and wider body. For placement select its intended load-bearing base or body-side patch according to the useful posture chosen from current RGB.
receiver_description: The uppermost receiving support of the wooden wine rack, not the lower shelf or table.
relevant_visual_cues: Uppermost rack receiving patch, slat gaps and edges
Empty hand clear while bottle remains on the top support

stages.name: Align above bottle
stages.goal: Position the open hand above a graspable bottle section.
stages.exit: The actor-selected source surface is coarsely aligned with the finger gap in world X/Y (each reference difference within 10mm), and current RGB supports a suitable approach orientation. This is not contact proof.
perception_inputs: Current bottle mask and visible orientation
Finger gap in fixed and wrist RGB
Nearby rack, bowl and cabinet boundaries

control_contract.translation: Align horizontally for the selected grasp relationship. The selected source dot is a surface reference, not a grasp centre.
control_contract.height: Maintain suitable overhead clearance. Already being safely above is not a reason to rise further.
control_contract.exit: Horizontal alignment and approach orientation are suitable; continue to descent.

stages.name: Descend around bottle
stages.goal: Bring the fingers alongside the selected section.
stages.exit: The hand appears positioned for a closure attempt. Proven contact is not required.

control_contract.translation: Approach the visually selected grasp region. Preserve horizontal alignment and account for finger geometry.
control_contract.exit: The hand appears positioned for a closure attempt. Proven contact is not required.

stages.name: Close
stages.goal: Close the fingers around the bottle.
stages.exit: Closure was attempted. Continue if engagement looks plausible; retry alignment if clearly missed.

control_contract.translation: Hold position unless a visible positioning problem requires returning to alignment.
control_contract.gripper: Attempt closure; then inspect the result.
control_contract.exit: Closure was attempted. Continue if engagement looks plausible; retry alignment if clearly missed.

stages.name: Lift
stages.goal: Briefly test whether your selected visible bottle feature rises with the closed hand before beginning combined reorientation and approach.
stages.exit: The camera-derived selected feature rises at least20mm and its motion agrees with measured own translation within10mm per axis, with a valid same-origin RGB match. This is a provisional motion test, not a contact or holding certificate.

control_contract.translation: Briefly test visible bottle following and table separation; rack-approach clearance is a later task.
control_contract.exit: The camera-derived selected feature rises at least20mm and its motion agrees with measured own translation within10mm per axis, with a valid same-origin RGB match. This is a provisional motion test, not a contact or holding certificate.
control_contract.failure: If the source does not follow, reassess the grasp.

stages.name: Establish visible bottle clearance
stages.goal: Establish a visible-bottle height margin above the upper support while preserving the provisional grasp and the own hand XY recorded at this phase entry. Lateral transport follows in the next phase.
stages.exit: A fresh partial visible-height estimate is available and this phase positional/rotation choices all hold. The estimate is not a complete-object clearance certificate.
perception_inputs: Visible bottle extent, selected support feature, top receiving patch, obstacle clearances and current hand-to-bottle relationship.

control_contract.references: Actor-selected load-bearing bottle feature and uppermost rack support patch; no compulsory posture.
control_contract.translation: Own phase-entry XY is the horizontal reference; partial lower-visible bottle versus upper-visible receiver is the height reference.
control_contract.exit: A fresh partial visible-height estimate is available and this phase positional/rotation choices all hold. The estimate is not a complete-object clearance certificate.
control_contract.gripper: Retain provisional closure during transport; release is a later phase.
control_contract.stage_decision_rule: First restart if visual recovery True. Otherwise continue if current partial-height estimate available=False. With a current available height estimate: ANY positive or negative in the SIX motion decisions means continue; ALL SIX hold means advance to transport. Source/receiver point labels are not needed for this own-entry-XY/visible-extent-height substage. Examples: [hold,hold,positive,hold,hold,hold] means continue; all six hold with available=True means advance; all six hold with available=False means continue.

stages.name: Transport with visible-body height margin
stages.goal: Bring the retained bottle over the upper rack while preserving the visible lower-body height margin. A changing neck skin point must not command away the established body clearance.
stages.exit: Fresh extent-height estimate and actor-selected horizontal references are available; the SIX direction choices all hold, ready to begin seating.
perception_inputs: Visible bottle extent, selected support feature, top receiving patch, obstacle clearances and current hand-to-bottle relationship.

control_contract.references: Actor-selected load-bearing bottle feature and uppermost rack support patch; no compulsory posture.
control_contract.translation: Which independent world-axis translations and rotations improve a clear approach to the top region while retaining the bottle?
control_contract.exit: Fresh extent-height estimate and actor-selected horizontal references are available; the SIX direction choices all hold, ready to begin seating.
control_contract.gripper: Retain provisional closure during transport; release is a later phase.
control_contract.stage_decision_rule: First restart if visual recovery True. Otherwise continue if current partial-height estimate available=False. With an available height estimate, Classify the CURRENT motion choices, not the future goal. Priority: visual recovery True means restart. Otherwise, when BOTH references are known, ANY positive or negative among X/Y/Z/rx/ry/rz means continue; ALL SIX hold means advance. With an unknown reference, use the visual transition recommendation, otherwise continue. Examples with known references and recovery False: [hold,hold,positive,hold,hold,hold] means continue; [hold,hold,hold,hold,hold,hold] means advance; [hold,hold,hold,negative,hold,hold] means continue. These answers only change the phase; they execute no motion.

stages.name: Seat on the top support
stages.goal: Position the retained bottle lower visible extent near the actor-selected upper receiving patch, preserving closure until the separate Release phase. Partial visible extents are not hidden underside or contact proof.
stages.exit: The selected support relationship is ready for an uncertain opening attempt. Load transfer and stability will be inspected AFTER opening.
perception_inputs: Updated source-to-support offsets, estimated footprint overlap, support gaps and edges, finger clearance, and bottle motion across views.

control_contract.references: Actor-selected load-bearing bottle feature and uppermost rack support patch; no compulsory posture.
control_contract.translation: Can the bottle be brought onto the top support without crossing an edge, entering a gap, colliding or requiring the fingers to carry it indefinitely?
control_contract.exit: The selected support relationship is ready for an uncertain opening attempt. Load transfer and stability will be inspected AFTER opening.
control_contract.gripper: Retain provisional closure during seating; do not merge positioning with opening.
control_contract.stage_decision_rule: First restart if visual recovery True. Otherwise continue if current partial-height estimate available=False. With an available height estimate, Classify the CURRENT motion choices, not the future goal. Priority: visual recovery True means restart. Otherwise, when BOTH references are known, ANY positive or negative among X/Y/Z/rx/ry/rz means continue; ALL SIX hold means advance. With an unknown reference, use the visual transition recommendation, otherwise continue. Examples with known references and recovery False: [hold,hold,positive,hold,hold,hold] means continue; [hold,hold,hold,hold,hold,hold] means advance; [hold,hold,hold,negative,hold,hold] means continue. These answers only change the phase; they execute no motion.

stages.name: Release
stages.goal: Attempt opening at the selected top-support placement; observe actual disengagement and support in the next inspection phase.
stages.exit: An opening attempt actually executed; advance provisionally to clearance and support inspection.

control_contract.exit: An opening attempt actually executed; advance provisionally to clearance and support inspection.

stages.name: Clear the hand and inspect
stages.goal: Inspect actual bottle separation and persistence on the upper rack; the bottle may already have reached support before the planned release.
stages.exit: Compare a genuinely earlier observation and CURRENT views. Advance when the bottle visibly remains on the UPPERMOST rack support while the fingers are separate and the hand is clear. It may have reached support before the planned Release phase; no particular bottle posture or hidden contact proof is needed. A gripper command alone does not prove separation. Do not infer persistence from duplicate observations with the same capture tick. Continue for an ordinary later observation if needed; restart for clearly displaced off-target placement. Hold the already clear hand instead of continuing to retreat indefinitely.
perception_inputs: A collision-free retreat view, visible empty fingers, and successive external views showing the bottle and both rack levels.

control_contract.references: Actor-selected load-bearing bottle feature and uppermost rack support patch; no compulsory posture.
control_contract.translation: Is the empty hand clear? Does the bottle remain on the upper receiving support, rather than on the table, lower shelf or in the fingers? Is continued sliding or rolling visible?
control_contract.exit: Compare a genuinely earlier observation and CURRENT views. Advance when the bottle visibly remains on the UPPERMOST rack support while the fingers are separate and the hand is clear. It may have reached support before the planned Release phase; no particular bottle posture or hidden contact proof is needed. A gripper command alone does not prove separation. Do not infer persistence from duplicate observations with the same capture tick. Continue for an ordinary later observation if needed; restart for clearly displaced off-target placement. Hold the already clear hand instead of continuing to retreat indefinitely.

coarse_alignment_scope: Outer experimental adaptation: explicit XY feature-positioning semantics; source reference and orientation remain actor choices. A 10mm stopping band is a control heuristic, not measured sensor accuracy. Z and rotations have no algorithmic target error.
